description: The Condition Data Collection is the Department for Education's survey of the condition of buildings in government-funded schools in England. The first round's key findings were published in May 2021 as the Condition of School Buildings Survey report. The second round, CDC2, visits every government-funded school between 2021 and 2026 to build a picture of the school estate; DfE uses it to inform condition funding allocations, prioritise investment, and identify buildings for rebuilding programmes, and a separate collection covers further education. The guidance page, published in December 2020 and last updated on 10 October 2024, holds the CDC2 programme guide and instructions for schools and responsible bodies to access their own condition reports. Coverage: government-funded schools in England. Access: programme guidance and summary reports are public; school-level reports go to schools and responsible bodies. Licence: GOV.UK publications under the Open Government Licence. Caveats: the detailed element-level condition data are not openly published, so external use relies on summaries. Simulation uses are condition inputs for school estate risk, ageing and investment models. Related records: Get Information about Schools.
